key_idea: When you unfold the paper, each hole gets a mirror twin on the other side of the fold.
steps: The fold is on the right side of the folded paper.
The top hole is close to the fold. The bottom hole is far from the fold, near the left edge.
When she unfolds, the top hole gets a twin close to the fold on the other side. So the top 2 holes sit next to the middle line.
The bottom hole gets a twin far from the fold. So the bottom 2 holes sit near the outer edges.

choice_feedback.A: The bottom holes are next to the middle line. They should be near the outer edges.
choice_feedback.B: The top holes are at the outer edges. They should be next to the middle line.
choice_feedback.D: This is the wrong way round. The top holes are far from the fold and the bottom holes are close to it.
choice_feedback.E: All the holes are the same distance from the fold, but the top and bottom holes were at different distances.
